description: Time series of hourly resolution electricity demand for European scale energy system studies is a data set deposited in DTU Data by its authors Shubham Nayak (Technical University of Denmark). This dataset provides Pan-European simulated hourly time series of electricity demand. The dataset comes from a simulating a linear time-series model. The model is described in Reference 1. The source code to generate the data is available in Reference 2. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 192429452 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
